definitions.gloss: karate, the way of the empty hand
definitions.explanation: A Japanese martial art originating from Okinawa that emphasizes striking techniques using punches, kicks, knee strikes, and open-hand techniques. The formal name for what is commonly called 空手.

examples.japanese: {空手道|からてどう}を{学|まな}んでいる。
{空手道|からてどう}は{沖縄|おきなわ}{発祥|はっしょう}の{武道|ぶどう}だ。
examples.english: Karate is a martial art originating from Okinawa.

examples.japanese: {空手道|からてどう}は2020{年|ねん}の{東京|とうきょう}オリンピックで{正式種目|せいしきしゅもく}になった。
examples.english: Karate became an official event at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{空|から} (empty) + {手|て} (hand) + {道|どう} (way/path)

The name means "the way of the empty hand," reflecting that it is primarily an unarmed martial art.

USAGE:
{空手道|からてどう} is the formal name. In everyday conversation, {空手|からて} is more commonly used. The ～{道|どう} suffix emphasizes it as a disciplined path of self-improvement, not just a fighting technique.

MAJOR STYLES:
- {松濤館流|しょうとうかんりゅう} (Shotokan)
- {剛柔流|ごうじゅうりゅう} (Goju-ryu)
- {糸東流|しとうりゅう} (Shito-ryu)
- {和道流|わどうりゅう} (Wado-ryu)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空手道|からてどう}の{道場|どうじょう}: karate dojo
- {空手道|からてどう}の{型|かた}: karate forms
- {空手道|からてどう}の{黒帯|くろおび}: karate black belt
